# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.9 Worker 2: 4 Colonial Charter Goals & Frontier Pacing 2.0 (oe_col2_). Generated by gen_v99_colonization.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Campaign-start / Age of Discovery one-shot exploration area preference assignment (1400+ only, zero pulse overhead).
oe_col2_assign_exploration_prefs = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1400
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_col2_prefs_seeded }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_col2_prefs_seeded value = 1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				is_rebel_country = no
				exists = capital
			}
			# European powers avoid premature deep interior Africa painting before coastal staging.
			if = {
				limit = {
					capital.continent = continent:europe
				}
				add_area_preference = oe_col2_avoid_premature_interior_africa
			}
			# Atlantic explorers follow historical island stepping stones.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						tag = POR
						tag = CAS
						tag = SPA
						tag = FRA
						tag = ENG
						tag = GBR
						tag = NED
					}
				}
				add_area_preference = oe_col2_atlantic_stepping_stones
			}
			# North Atlantic / East Coast explorers steer cleanly toward the Chesapeake & New England coast.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						tag = ENG
						tag = GBR
						tag = FRA
						tag = NED
					}
				}
				add_area_preference = oe_col2_chesapeake_elysia_corridor
			}
			# East Slavic states follow historical Ural-Siberia river corridors.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						tag = MOS
						tag = RUS
						tag = NOV
					}
				}
				add_area_preference = oe_col2_siberian_river_corridor
			}
			# Eastern Mediterranean, Red Sea, and Zheng He-era (1400-1450) Ming/Yuan maritime powers follow Indian Ocean lanes.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						oe_far_roman_host = yes
						tag = VEN
						tag = GEN
						tag = MAM
						AND = {
							current_year >= 1400
							current_year <= 1450
							NOT = { has_or_had_tag = MCH }
							OR = {
								tag = CHI
								tag = MNG
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add_area_preference = oe_col2_red_sea_indian_ocean_corridor
			}
		}
	}
}

# Activate v10.5 Nova Elysia frontier hook on a country (callable by v10.5 or BYZ/ROM East Coast landing).
oe_col2_activate_elysia_hook = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_col2_elysia_frontier_hook value = 1 }
	add_area_preference = oe_col2_chesapeake_elysia_corridor
}

# Link a newly chartered coastal hub (scope:new_town) into v9.0 Far Seas Plan A when active.
# Expects scope:owner (charter actor), scope:target (province_definition), and scope:new_town (location).
oe_col2_link_far_seas_factoria = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:new_town
			scope:new_town = {
				has_owner = yes
				is_coastal = yes
			}
		}
		scope:new_town = {
			change_building_level_in_location = {
				building = building_type:oe_col2_charter_customs_house
				value = 1
			}
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_col2_maritime_factoria_mod
				years = 15
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		# Roman host (BYZ/ROM) with Far Seas Plan A active: connect Eastern corridor to oe_far_exarchate_trade
		# dividend pool and Western corridor to oe_far_exarchate territorial subject.
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = { oe_far_roman_host = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:new_town = { oe_col2_in_eastern_factoria_corridor = yes }
					oe_far_east_open = yes
				}
				scope:new_town = {
					set_variable = { name = oe_far_post_active value = 1 }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = scope:owner }
					add_location_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_col2_factoria_dividend_link
						years = 20
						mode = replace
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_global_variable = oe_far_east_co
						country_exists = global_var:oe_far_east_co
					}
					global_var:oe_far_east_co = {
						save_scope_as = oe_col2_east_co_ref
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:oe_col2_east_co_ref = {
								is_subject_of = scope:owner
								is_subject_type = oe_far_exarchate_trade
							}
						}
						scope:new_town = {
							add_to_variable_list = {
								name = oe_far_admitted
								target = scope:oe_col2_east_co_ref
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_east_n }
					change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_east_n add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					scope:new_town = { continent = continent:america }
					oe_far_west_open = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:new_town = { oe_col2_in_elysia_coast = yes }
					}
					scope:owner = { oe_col2_activate_elysia_hook = yes }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_global_variable = oe_far_west_co
						country_exists = global_var:oe_far_west_co
					}
					global_var:oe_far_west_co = {
						save_scope_as = oe_col2_west_co_ref
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:oe_col2_west_co_ref = {
								is_subject_of = scope:owner
								is_subject_type = oe_far_exarchate
							}
						}
						scope:target = {
							every_location_in_province_definition = {
								change_location_owner = scope:oe_col2_west_co_ref
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_variable = oe_far_west_n }
					change_global_variable = { name = oe_far_west_n add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Seed region-matched Cossack frontier host pops & Ostrog fortification at scope:new_town / scope:target.
oe_col2_settle_cossack_ostrog = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:new_town
			scope:new_town = { has_owner = yes }
		}
		scope:new_town = {
			change_building_level_in_location = {
				building = building_type:oe_col2_cossack_ostrog
				value = 1
			}
			if = {
				limit = { region = region:ural_region }
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:oe_ural_cossack
					religion = scope:owner.religion
					type = pop_type:soldiers
					size = 0.25
				}
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:oe_ural_cossack
					religion = scope:owner.religion
					type = pop_type:peasants
					size = 0.35
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { region = region:west_siberia_region }
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:oe_siberian_cossack
					religion = scope:owner.religion
					type = pop_type:soldiers
					size = 0.25
				}
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:oe_siberian_cossack
					religion = scope:owner.religion
					type = pop_type:peasants
					size = 0.35
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { region = region:east_siberia_region }
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:oe_transbaikal_cossack
					religion = scope:owner.religion
					type = pop_type:soldiers
					size = 0.25
				}
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:oe_transbaikal_cossack
					religion = scope:owner.religion
					type = pop_type:peasants
					size = 0.35
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { region = region:steppes_region }
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:oe_don_cossack
					religion = scope:owner.religion
					type = pop_type:soldiers
					size = 0.25
				}
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:oe_don_cossack
					religion = scope:owner.religion
					type = pop_type:peasants
					size = 0.35
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_pop = {
					culture = scope:owner.culture
					religion = scope:owner.religion
					type = pop_type:soldiers
					size = 0.25
				}
				add_pop = {
					culture = scope:owner.culture
					religion = scope:owner.religion
					type = pop_type:peasants
					size = 0.35
				}
			}
		}
	}
	scope:target = {
		every_location_in_province_definition = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_col2_cossack_ostrog_mod
				years = 20
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
}

# Settle contiguous soldier-farmer Limes garrison colonists in scope:target / scope:new_town.
oe_col2_settle_limes_colony = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:new_town
			scope:new_town = { has_owner = yes }
		}
		scope:new_town = {
			add_pop = {
				culture = scope:owner.culture
				religion = scope:owner.religion
				type = pop_type:soldiers
				size = 0.35
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:stockade }
					NOT = { has_building = building_type:castle }
				}
				change_building_level_in_location = {
					building = building_type:stockade
					value = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	scope:target = {
		every_location_in_province_definition = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_col2_limes_colony_mod
				years = 20
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
}

# Establish a peaceful missionary settlement preserving native population with slower colonization tradeoff.
oe_col2_settle_ecumenical_mission = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:new_town
			scope:new_town = { has_owner = yes }
		}
		scope:new_town = {
			add_pop = {
				culture = scope:owner.culture
				religion = scope:owner.religion
				type = pop_type:clergy
				size = 0.15
			}
		}
	}
	scope:target = {
		every_location_in_province_definition = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_col2_peaceful_mission_mod
				years = 25
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
	scope:owner = {
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col2_mission_charter_pace
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Throttled dispatcher for Native Diplomacy & Frontier Integration event chain (15-year cooldown).
oe_col2_dispatch_native_diplomacy = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_col2_native_cd }
			has_variable = oe_col2_last_colony_loc
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_col2_native_cd years = 15 value = 1 }
		# Prioritize Nova Elysia Foederati variant when Roman host / v10.5 settles North American East Coast.
		if = {
			limit = {
				oe_col2_elysia_frontier_hook_trigger = yes
				var:oe_col2_last_colony_loc = {
					has_owner = yes
					oe_col2_in_elysia_coast = yes
				}
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col2_native.2
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_col2_last_charter_type ?= 2
				var:oe_col2_last_colony_loc = {
					has_owner = yes
					oe_col2_in_steppe_siberia_zone = yes
				}
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col2_native.3
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_col2_last_charter_type ?= 1
				var:oe_col2_last_colony_loc = {
					has_owner = yes
					is_coastal = yes
					oe_col2_in_eastern_factoria_corridor = yes
				}
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col2_native.4
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col2_native.1
		}
	}
}
